name_input: M/S FINOLEX CABLES LTD; M/S FINOLEX CABLES LIMITED; M/S FINOLEX CABLE LTD.; M/S FINOLEX CABLES LTD.,; FINOLEX CABLE LTD; FINOLEX CABLES LIMITED; FINOLEX CABLES LTD.; FINOLEX CABLES LTD; FINOLEX CABLES LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/finolex-cables-ltd loaded but contained only the placeholder line "Number of shipments by month: For more data search from above search box" — 0 shipment rows rendered, 0 bill-of-lading numbers, 0 dates, 0 destinations visible. Volza (https://www.volza.com/p/finolex-cables/export/export-from-india/) returned HTTP 403, Eximpedia returned HTTP 403, Trademo returned HTTP 403, ImportGenius returned a JavaScript 'Client Challenge' page. No export record with date/destination/HS/B-L could be read from any source.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved: finolex.com investor URLs tried (/investors, /reports-and-financial-results, /annual-reports) all returned the site's own "Page you are looking for is not found!" error page, and the DuckDuckGo search backend failed on every query with 'searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>'. 0 domestic supply records seen.
note: Evidence could not be gathered, not evidence of absence. Source counter: 6 sources attempted (ImportKey, Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo, ImportGenius, finolex.com) — 0 usable shipment or turnover rows actually seen. Both statuses set to unknown rather than none_found, because the failure was tooling (403/JS walls, dead search backend, wrong site paths), not a demonstrated lack of shipments. Declared HS 900110 (optical fibre bundles/cables) is plausible for this company's OFC product line, but HS was not verified against any customs record and no correction is proposed here. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in anything I could read; not estimated. No CIN/PAN asserted. Recommend re-run with a working search backend and a paid/authenticated customs-data view before any verdict.
